description_en: Runs a Cloud Governance Center governance check
description_zh: 运行云治理中心治理检测
kebab_example: aliyun governance run-evaluation --account-id 1766185894100000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --scope ResourceDirectory --metric-ids xfyve50000 --evaluation-domain example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunEvaluation

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member account. This parameter is applicable only to the multi-account check pattern
parameters.help_zh: 成员账号ID。该参数仅适用于多账号检测模式
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en:
The scope of the governance maturity check. Valid values:

Account (default): runs a single-account governance maturity check that checks only the current account.
ResourceDirectory: runs a multi-account governance maturity check that checks all member accounts in the resource directory. Before you perform this operation, upgrade to the multi-account governance maturity check
parameters.help_zh:
治理成熟度检测范围。取值：

Account（默认）：运行单账号治理成熟度检测，仅检测当前账号。
ResourceDirectory：运行多账号治理成熟度检测，即检测资源目录所有成员账号。操作前，需要先升级至多账号治理成熟度检测
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en: The list of check item IDs to check
parameters.help_zh: 需要检测的检测项ID列表
parameters.name: metric_ids
